senses.gloss: c. (= h. מִלָּה; מְלַל II) word, command; (cmp. דָּבָר) thing, object, affair, subject &c.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 41:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 27:26">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVII, 26</cite>.—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:2">Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16ᵈ <he>כל מילה באתרה</he> every subject in its proper place (not digressing); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8:7">Y. Erub. VI, end, 24ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מלא ומלא</he> (not <he>ימלא</he>).
Lev. R. s. 24; Y. Yeb. II, 3ᵈ מ׳ בישא something bad (euphem. for pollution); a. fr.—Pl. מִילִּין, מִילַּיָּא, מילֵּי, מִלּ׳.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:2">Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 21:13">Targ. Jud. XXI, 13</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 139b:15">Ḥull. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר לי חנינא מ׳</he> said Ḥănina to me, These are (idle) words; <he>מ׳ ס״ד אלא אימא במ׳</he> you cannot mean that this is an untruth? But say, it was done through words (of charm, v. <cite ref="M01198"><he>מִילְּתָא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:9">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 22a:1">Ned. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דעזיבה</he> (Ar. <he>דעזובה</he>) things (actions) of an abandoned woman.

<cite ref="Gittin 29a:7">Gitt. 29ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ לא ממסרן וכ׳</he> words cannot be transferred to a deputy, i.e. an order authorizing somebody is not transferable; <cite ref="Gittin 71b:10">ib. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ממסרן וכ׳</he> an order is transferable.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 77a:1">B. Bath. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>אותיות מ׳ נינהו ומ׳ במ׳ וכ׳</he> letters (documents) are words (symbols of value) and words cannot be taken possession of by means of words (by a document of assignment, but the original document must be handed over); a. v. fr.—

Erub. 2ᵃ סוכה דנפישין מיליה (corrected in Ms. M. מִילָּהָה) Succah (Succ. I, 1) about which much is said (several disqualifications stated); מבוי דלא נפישי מִילֵּיה Mabuy (Erub. I, about which not much is said (only one disqualification is mentioned); Succ. 2ᵃ סוכה דנפישי מִילָּהָא Ms. M. 2 (Ms. M. 1 מילה, ed. מִילָּתָהּ); דלא נפיש מִילֵּיה (sing.).—מנא הני מילי, מנהני מ׳ (abbrev. מה״מ) whence is it proved? Ḥull. 140ᵃ.
Ib. 24ᵇ; a. v. fr.—הני מילי, v. הָן.—מ׳ דשמיא divine, religious affairs.
Keth. 105ᵇ; a. fr.—מ׳ דעלמא secular, trivial affairs.
<cite ref="Shabbat 82a">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[For other combinations see the respective determinants.]—V. <cite ref="M01198"><he>מִילְּתָא</he></cite>.
